definitions.primary: Source-identified prime target, not a measured fraction of muscle force.
definitions.secondary: Upstream synergist/secondary candidate; may be approximate.
definitions.stabilizers: Candidate stabilizing role, generally conditional; needs verification.
definitions.regions: Training emphasis hypotheses; not isolated muscles and not load percentages.
definitions.mobility: Target tissue of stretching, not a strength-training volume unit.
definitions.name_ru_candidate: Proposed Russian name, not certified as accepted terminology.
definitions.review: Every exercise requires case-specific name and anatomy review before production use.
